description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons: liquefied, natural gas
Poultry: live, ducks, geese, turkeys and guinea fowls, weighing more than 185g
Vegetable roots and tubers: yautia (Xanthosoma spp.) with high starch or inulin content, fresh, chilled, frozen or dried, whether or not sliced or in the form of pellets
Sulphur of all kinds: other than sublimed, precipitated and colloidal sulphur
Slag, ash and residues: (not from the manufacture of iron or steel), containing mainly aluminium
Sodium hydroxide (caustic soda): in aqueous solution (soda lye or liquid soda)
Acyclic hydrocarbons: unsaturated, n.e.c. in heading no. 2901
Cyclic hydrocarbons: n.e.c. in heading no. 2902
Unsaturated chlorinated derivatives of acyclic hydrocarbons: vinyl chloride (chloroethylene)
Printed matter: in single sheets, whether or not folded
Steel, alloy: bars and rods, hot-rolled, in irregularly wound coils, of high speed steel
Copper: table, kitchen or other household articles and parts thereof: pot scourers and scouring or polishing pads, gloves and the like
Waste and scrap of primary cells, primary batteries and electric accumulators: spent primary cells, spent primary batteries and spent electric accumulators
Cruise ships, excursion boats and similar vessels, principally designed for the transport of persons, ferry boats of all kinds
Yachts and other vessels: for pleasure or sports, rowing boats and canoes, n.e.c. in heading no. 8903, other than inflatable
Projectors, cinematographic: whether or not incorporating sound recording or reproducing apparatus
